reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest") flows to bar via replaceAll("<[^>]+>", ""), then to response.getWriter(). At the sink, bar contains attacker-controlled content. The regex sanitization is insufficient - it only removes well-formed <...> tags but allows event handlers like to pass through unchanged, enabling XSS exploitation.

evidence.note: User input param -> sanitize via regex -> write to response. Regex '<[^>]+' only removes complete tags, leaving event handlers intact
